notation.alpha: Strictly positive per-link Casimir energy coefficient
notation.tau: alpha*N*(N+2), lower threshold for omitted indices n>=N
notation.R: Exact rational comparison threshold satisfying certified mu_1(A_N)<R<tau
notation.A_N: Finite compression of exact Jacobi Hamiltonian

axioms_and_definitions.statement: Four independent links on one square with four distinct vertices; no repeated-edge identifications.
SU(2), normalized Haar measure, fundamental generators sigma_a/2.
Independent vertex gauge invariance, no external charges or matter.
Per-link positive Casimir has spin-j eigenvalue j(j+1).
H=alpha*sum_e C_e+lambda*(1-ReTr U_p/2), alpha>0 and finite lambda>=0.
hbar=1; alpha and lambda are energy coefficients; time already continuous.

theorems.statement: The one-square physical Hilbert space is unitarily equivalent to L2(SU2)^Ad with character basis chi_(n/2).
failure_controls: Independently gauged open-link endpoints leave only constants.
Two adjacent loops require simultaneous conjugation and relative orientation.
